annotations.title: Find a Parky park or ride

description: Use this when a visitor names or describes a ride and you need its Parky ID, or to check which parks Parky covers. Park tools take a park name directly, so skip this for them. Searches only parks in Parky's current Disney and Universal release scope. It does not retrieve current wait times.

park_id.description: Optional canonical Parky park ID to narrow ride search.

query.description: Park or ride name, such as EPCOT or Hagrid's.
